Deng S, McTiernan N, Wei X, Arnesen T, Marmorstein R. Nat Commun 2020;11:818. PMID 32042062, PMC7010799, doi:10.1038/s41467-020-14584-7 (Europe PMC full-text XML)

claims.evidence: PRIDE lists only three RAW ZIPs; their central directories contain exactly 14 .raw members (Exp1 5, Exp2 6, Exp3 3), each used once.

Methods: HeLa cells transfected with pcDNA3.1/NAA15-WT-V5, -T406Y-V5 or -L814P-V5 and V5-immunoprecipitated. Supplementary Data 1 column headers name the variant per MaxQuant raw file (e.g. 'iBAQ NAA15-T406Y-V5 Rep1 (Raw file: 6_NMC_1)').
Supplementary Fig. 2 legend: 'n = 3 biologically independent experiments'; Source Data 'Fig. 3a' sheet lists Experiment 1, 2 and 3; deposit splits RAW and search output into Experiment1/2/3.

Within Exp1/Exp2 each a/b (or _1/_2) pair was injected from the same autosampler vial (Exp1: GA2 for 6_NMC_1/6_NMC_2, GA3 for 7_NMC_1/7_NMC_2; Exp2: BB3 for 2_WT-a/b, BB4 for 3_T406Y-a/b, BB5 for 4_814P-a/b), so they are repeat injections of one IP digest. Supplementary Data 1 labels them Rep1/Rep2.
One source per IP sample (variant x experiment); same-vial injections share a source.

claims.value: Homo sapiens; uterine cervix; cervical adenocarcinoma; 30Y6M; female
claims.evidence: Cellosaurus CVCL_0030: derived from uterine cervix (UBERON:0000002), NCIt C27677 HPV-related endocervical adenocarcinoma (mapped to MONDO:0005153 cervical adenocarcinoma), donor 30Y6M, female. PRIDE organism NEWT:9606.
sdrf-tools cellline lookup HeLa reports cell type 'epithelial'; CL:0000066. Cellosaurus JSON carries no cell-type field; see limitations.
Methods: transient plasmid transfection with X-tremeGENE 9; EFO:0000726.
All 14 RAW headers: 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS'; paper Methods: Q-Exactive HF. PRIDE field says generic 'Q Exactive' (MS:1001911) and is overridden.

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[dissociation method] rows 1-14
claims.evidence: Methods: data-dependent mode, top 12, NCE 28%. RAW instrument method names: 'TOP12HCD' (Exp1, Exp3) and 'TOP15HCD' (Exp2).
Methods: Sequencing Grade Modified Trypsin (Promega), FASP. summary.txt: Enzyme Trypsin, Specific for every raw file.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M variable; Acetyl Protein N-term variable
claims.evidence: summary.txt per raw file: Fixed modifications Carbamidomethyl (C); Variable modifications Oxidation (M);Acetyl (Protein N-term). Same in data processing protocol.
parameters.txt: MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm in all three searches.
Eluted in FASP buffer with 0.1 M DTT; Cys-alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide.

limitations: Two MaxQuant-searched control runs of Exp2 (1_Ctrl-a, 1_Ctrl-b) are not in the deposit and are not annotated; the deposited Exp1 WT run is the second injection 5_NMC_2 and no 5_NMC_1 run is deposited or searched.

Whether the a/b runs differ only by injection is inferred from identical vial positions in the RAW headers; Exp2 a and b runs used different instrument methods (07b ... 2mmSH vs 07a ... 1mmSH), not described in the paper.
The paper describes one MS method (TOP12, 120k MS1); Exp2 RAW method names say TOP15 60K-15K. Scan range, resolution and collision energy are therefore not written.
Precursor mass tolerance is not in the deposited parameters.txt and not stated in the paper ('All other parameters were set to default values'); written as not available.
Cell type 'epithelial cell' comes from the sdrf-tools curated cell-line table, not from the Cellosaurus record JSON.
Ancestry: Cellosaurus genome ancestry is admixed (African 64.7%, European ~32%); no single HANCESTRO category; not available.
Passage number and culture medium are not stated in the paper; not available.
No ontology term under EFO:0009090 fits co-immunoprecipitation, so characteristics[enrichment process] is omitted; the V5 IP is described in the report only.
